name: Mamiya Rinzō to Sakhalin and the Amur
summary: Sent by the shogunate to find whether Karafuto (Sakhalin) is an island, Mamiya travels north with Ainu and Nivkh guides, finds the narrow strait that separates it from the mainland, and crosses to the Amur to visit the Qing trading post at Deren.

stops.note: Crosses from the northern tip of Ezo.
Reaches the narrows: Karafuto is an island.
The Qing trading post where Nivkh and Ainu bring furs.
Home; his maps name the strait that Europeans later call Tatar.
